data.name: Devidas Rakte
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Devidas Rakte has made a big mark in cricket. With 2 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 15, with an average of 11.50 and a quick strike rate of 153.33. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 1 sixes and 3 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 6.0 overs, taking 3 wickets at an economy rate of 11.83. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
